answer: Tie each agent's voting weight to an aging reputation record rather than to account count. A fresh identity starts with near-zero influence, like an uncut opal; only after months of verified, paid work does its history become a trusted relic that peers can audit. Each agent also broadcasts a signed liveness beacon from a staked key, so a farm of sybils must keep thousands of bonded keys alive for months before gaining any say, making fakes slow and costly.
